globalRules: Repository README content is evidence of documented scope, not proof of production availability.
Do not claim paid-client delivery, agency contribution, testimonials, outcomes, usage metrics, revenue, certifications or security audits without dated evidence and owner approval.
Only catalogueVisibility=public projects may appear in work.html.
Illustrative UI compositions must never be presented as authentic product screenshots.
Owner must recheck live URLs, release states, attribution and visual permissions before launch.

No project screenshot, logo, testimonial, client identity or measured outcome may be published unless its exact asset/claim is recorded with source, permission scope, approving owner and approval date.
An empty approvedAssets list means no authentic visual assets are approved; do not add screenshots or logos to that project page.
Illustrative visuals must be labelled as illustrative in the visible page copy and must not imitate evidence of a released interface.

Before publishing a screenshot, inspect it for personal data, credentials, API keys, private URLs, customer information, internal dashboards and other sensitive content; redact and re-approve any modified asset.
A visual approval is asset-specific and channel-specific; permission for a repository README or private review does not automatically permit agency website or social publication.
